title: `Pot.drip` and `Jug.drip` Block-Timestamp Update Vulnerability Allows DSR / Stability Fee Manipulation and Accounting Desynchronization
vuln_type: State Machine / Logic Flaw / Economic Attack
impact: Malicious actors or miners can exploit the strict `now == rho` dependency combined with asynchronous `drip` execution to manipulate debt accumulation, lock savings rate accrual, or force out-of-bounds state transitions, leading to protocol insolvency or unjust inflation of the `chi` rate accumulator.
